chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign.name: chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign
chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign.value:
(type IN ('RECEIPT', 'TRANSFER_IN', 'PRODUCTION_IN', 'ADJUSTMENT_IN') AND quantity > 0)
          OR (type IN ('ISSUE', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'PRODUCTION_OUT', 'ADJUSTMENT_OUT') AND quantity < 0)

chk_iqc_inspections_aql_level_valid.name: chk_iqc_inspections_aql_level_valid
chk_iqc_inspections_aql_level_valid.value: aql_level IS NULL OR aql_level = ANY(ARRAY[0.65,1.0,1.5,2.5,4.0,6.5])

chk_iqc_inspections_sort_qty_pair.name: chk_iqc_inspections_sort_qty_pair
chk_iqc_inspections_sort_qty_pair.value: (sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL) OR (sort_ok_qty IS NOT NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NOT NULL AND sort_ok_qty >= 0 AND sort_ng_qty >= 0)

chk_iqc_inspections_sort_qty_requires_so.name: chk_iqc_inspections_sort_qty_requires_sort
chk_iqc_inspections_sort_qty_requires_so.value: (sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL) OR disposition = 'SORT'

chk_iqc_inspections_sort_qty_total.name: chk_iqc_inspections_sort_qty_total
chk_iqc_inspections_sort_qty_total.value: sort_ok_qty IS NULL OR sort_ok_qty + sort_ng_qty = quantity

chk_oqc_inspections_aql_level_valid.name: chk_oqc_inspections_aql_level_valid
chk_oqc_inspections_aql_level_valid.value: aql_level IS NULL OR aql_level = ANY(ARRAY[0.65,1.0,1.5,2.5,4.0,6.5])

chk_outsourcing_orders_expected_return_d.name: chk_outsourcing_orders_expected_return_date
chk_outsourcing_orders_expected_return_d.value: expected_return_date IS NULL OR expected_return_date >= send_date

chk_production_orders_status_fields.name: chk_production_orders_status_fields
chk_production_orders_status_fields.value:
(status = 'PENDING' AND code IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL)
          OR (status = 'APPROVED' AND code IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)

chk_production_job_materials_qty.name: chk_production_job_materials_qty
chk_production_job_materials_qty.value: (unit_qty IS NULL OR unit_qty > 0) AND required_qty > 0
